description: Repairs an old or damaged photo of the user's (a photographed print, most often one from list_photos with uploads), paid from their credits: repair fixes scratches, tears and stains, faces enhances them, colourise adds colour to a black and white one. mode motion instead removes motion blur from a photo smeared by movement (a shaky night shot, people moving through the frame): it redraws the photo clean, small faces and lettering in a crowd included, and takes no switches. size 1K is Standard, 2K High quality, 4K Print quality; the price is by size, the same in either mode. Pass the price the user agreed to as max_credits: the photo's prices from get_shoot or list_photos name it. If a call to this tool got no answer, it may already have started: check list_photos before calling it again.

again.description: true only when the user, having seen what this same call made, asks for another (a second re-roll of one photo, another take of one shoot). Without it, the same call repeated within 10 minutes answers with what it made and charges nothing: a request already answered is not a new one.

name: restore
title: Restore an old photo, or remove motion blur
